6e44705b-9f80-42f6-9ebb-1141fbe8320e.title: Nozomanu Fushi no Boukensha
6e44705b-9f80-42f6-9ebb-1141fbe8320e.description: It's been ten years since Rentt Faina, a down-on-his luck Bronze-class adventurer, set his eyes on becoming Mithril-class. Unfortunately, Rentt finds himself helpless when confronted by a legendary Dragon in the Labyrinth of the Moon's Reflection... and is summarily eaten. But Rentt has miraculously reawakened... as a skeleton?

chapters.title: As Long as We Go Together

d41afbd7-3fbf-45b1-813c-b2d8244d69b2.title: Death March kara Hajimaru Isekai Kyousoukyoku
d41afbd7-3fbf-45b1-813c-b2d8244d69b2.altTitle: Death March to the Parallel World Rhapsody
d41afbd7-3fbf-45b1-813c-b2d8244d69b2.description: 29-year-old programmer Suzuki Ichirou finds himself transported into a fantasy RPG. Within the game, he's a 15-year-old named Satou. At first he thinks he's dreaming, but his experiences seem very real. Due to his use of a 3-time-use special power (meteor shower), he ends up wiping out an army of lizardmen and becoming very high level. He hides his level and plans to live peacefully and meet new people, though developments in the game story (like the return of a demon king) might get in his way.

c82afca5-b16d-41d1-93d9-fcea21f7f264.title: Kikai Shikake no Senmetsu Shoujo
c82afca5-b16d-41d1-93d9-fcea21f7f264.description: Adel, un Técnico con la habilidad de «crear objetos a partir de materiales», era considerado inútil en combate y un lastre para el grupo más poderoso de la ciudad de Isaac, «Torbellino Dorado». Un día, es expulsado repentinamente. Desesperado, Adel recibe una misteriosa petición de la familia del Conde Cartlett, quienes fueron asesinados por ladrones…

c8909273-7dea-4739-ac2e-c24da08b0b93.title: Angnyeogyosil
c8909273-7dea-4739-ac2e-c24da08b0b93.description:
Heo Jeong-woo, a high school student who is bullied by a girl in his class for his weakness.
 
Han Bo-ra, a transfer student, comes to Jeong-woo's class, where he was spending his miserable days.

Jeong-woo feels a strong sense of déjà vu when he sees the child with straight black hair and stains on his legs. Sure enough, Han Bo-ra, who has subdued the arguing classmates, asks them.

"'Have you ever seen a child similar to me?

Jeong-woo decides to approach Bo-ra, who might be able to correct what is wrong...

aa81f925-593c-4e84-8277-c6cc683eb85f.title: Surviving as a Butler at the Connate Castle
aa81f925-593c-4e84-8277-c6cc683eb85f.description:
Brienne is deprived of her title by her cousin and is in danger of being sold off to an ugly middle-aged aristocrat. So she dressed as a man and ran away, but the difficulty of finding a job was serious. The only good-paying job she found was a butler of the notoriously vicious Duke of Connate!
"The weekly salary is 2 gold!"
It was too much pay to refuse. So Brienne tried to save money and leave as soon as possible without being noticed by the Duke of Connate, but for some reason she ended up smitten by the duke.

2ff0eba0-6bdd-4497-9d32-8f7c9887f839.description: Back in sixth grade, Mirei hurt her best friend Soprano with heartless words after she confessed to her. Five years later, Soprano, now a famous model, transfers to Mirei's high school. While Mirei hopes to reconcile with Soprano and go back to being friends with her, friendship isn't what's on Soprano's mind.

a722d539-31db-4622-9ec8-c8d3ab5ff204.title: First Love Operation
a722d539-31db-4622-9ec8-c8d3ab5ff204.description:
Yeonwoo and Jisoo is a childhood friends and despite knowing that both of them are aware of their feelings for each other, instead of able to express it through words, it becomes a misunderstanding and conflicts. Although they both go to the same kindergarten till college, they still don’t have the right time to confess towards each other.

As the time goes by, the obstacles that those two have keeps increasing. Whether it’s Yeonwoo’s confession nor Jisoo’s confession, neither of them succeeded at it and instead, it seems like the failures have slowly keep them apart… When will they be able to convey their feelings?

eb5aaae8-4255-4c45-b1f5-8ce6bf34dcb8.title: Space Cheon-ma 3077
eb5aaae8-4255-4c45-b1f5-8ce6bf34dcb8.description: Qi, swords, martial artists… and robots and spaceships?! The year is 3077, thousands of years after the heyday of the martial arts realm. Humanity inhabits the stars, governed by interstellar martial arts organizations who kept the old ways of the realm alive: might makes right! For bounty hunters like Seryeong, Robert, and Sunja, this means trouble is good for business, except when they bite off more than they can chew. After venturing to the irradiated wasteland of Earth for a top bounty, only to find a 2,000-year-old martial artist instead, they realize their fortunes are about to change…

e7cd9c62-e3e8-4e71-8050-691bc7f3015e.title: Secret Love Affair Between a Former Saint and a Dark Hero
e7cd9c62-e3e8-4e71-8050-691bc7f3015e.altTitle: The Former Saintess and the Grey Eminence's Clandestine Love Affair
e7cd9c62-e3e8-4e71-8050-691bc7f3015e.description:
Kim Jiyeon, a college student on hiatus living an ordinary life, suddenly finds herself transmigrated into the romance novel *Saint's Flower* shown to her by a friend. She becomes the character Iolara, who only appeared halfway through the novel. The romantic world of the female lead and the male lead, which clearly isn't hers.

Still, she thought she could be happy as one of the characters in the novel. Like she had become the novel's protagonist. But everyone despises her. Hates her.

She's Iolara, the villain who torments the female lead, a fake saint. But it's not true. Iolara herself was the true saint.

Returning to the beginning with the blessings of the gods, she didn't need her family, the people who hated her, the position of the saint, or her beloved fiancé. She was going to walk a different path from her past.

"Even if this world tries to make me a villain, it doesn't matter. I will survive and be happy!"

2db03b07-89be-4cbe-978b-93648086d88f.title: I Became the Daughter of the Ghost Duke
2db03b07-89be-4cbe-978b-93648086d88f.altTitle: I Became the Ghost Duke's Daughter
2db03b07-89be-4cbe-978b-93648086d88f.description:
Theresia Oblene, eight years old.

As her dead mother’s things which she left were taken hostage, she was threatened by her wicked biological father and was forced to be adopted by the Ghost Duke family.

“But he only told me to go to be adopted, right? He didn’t tell me not to have this adoption undone, did he?”

Now that it has become like this, I’ll leave my name behind as the fastest child to get a dissolution of adoption in the history of the Empire.

===

An heir’s duty? What’s that? Is it something to be eaten?

It was my plan to become a lout and get kicked out on purpose.

Until I met the Ghost Duke who was cursed.

[Let me do this kind of thing as a parent, Terry.]

[I will become the Miss’ wooden horse!]

[Thank you, Miss!]

The Duke is too kind, and the employees are too sweet.

If so… then change of plans!

I decided to raise the Duke Family which is doomed, and buy the whole Viscount family.

Shouldn’t I use the ability to see ghosts at times like this?

But…

[Hey, you. If you keep pretending not to know… I will tell the ghosts of the mansion that you can see ghosts.]

My ability was found out by some ghost possessing a teddy bear.

Will… I be able to survive here safely?

274a8e39-71a8-4bd2-af19-4572518fe44f.title: Simhaesu
274a8e39-71a8-4bd2-af19-4572518fe44f.description:
The endless monsoon began when an icy comet collided with the Moon, triggering a catastrophic flood on Earth. For 70 years, unrelenting rain fell, ultimately submerging the entire planet.

Having lost their land, humanity's survival now depends on life at sea. The once-dominant species that ruled the Earth is no more. Sea creatures, mutated into grotesque beings known as "leviathans," now pose a deadly threat to human life. 

As the world teeters on the brink of collapse, two siblings, Bota and Rita, must navigate a dangerous new reality filled with monstrous threats, human conflict, and the destruction of the environment.

944729e5-a312-4d76-ba46-994802715a5e.title: New World Meow
944729e5-a312-4d76-ba46-994802715a5e.description:
Shin Se (a police-dog) is in charge of the stealth investigation who undergoes ears plastic surgery then enters the cat's territory pretending to be a cat and lives as a mafia mercenary. He has to suffer from many trials and pains to live like a cat.  
Will he be able to complete his mission while hiding his identity until the end?
